items.text: landuru ne ogendini duto gima osetimo.
chuny joma manyo Jehova Nyasaye mondo obed mamor.
En e Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa;
weche mane osingo e tienge tara,
Ne ogure ne Jakobo kaka chik,
kendo nogure ni Israel kaka singruok mochwere, kowacho ni,
Kane pod gin ji manok e kar rombgi,
ne ginok ahinya kendo ne gin welo e pinyno,
ne giwuotho e kind ogendini mopogore,
ka gidhi e pinyruodhi mopogore opogore.
Ne ok oyie mondo ngʼato osandgi;
kendo noketho yore duto mane giyudogo chiemo;
ngʼatno ne en Josef mane oloki kaka misumba.
Ne giridho tiendene gi arungu mochuoye chuma,
kendo ne giridho ngʼute gi chumbe,
nyaka nochopo kinde ma gik mane okoro notimore,
nyaka wach Jehova Nyasaye nochopo kare.
Ruodh Misri nooro wach mi nogonye
manorito gik moko duto mane en-go,
mondo en ema ne otieg jotende kaka ohero
Jakobo nodoko jadak e piny Ham.
Jehova Nyasaye nomiyo joge onya ahinya;
nomiyo gibedo mathoth ma wasikgi ne ok nyal nyalogi,
wasikgi ma noloko chunygi mondo ocha joge,
kendo noketo chunye mar timo ne jotichne marach.
Negitimo ranyisi mag honni e diergi,
ee, negitimo timbene miwuoro e piny Ham.
Nooro mudho mi nomiyo piny olil
nimar donge ne gisengʼanyo ne wechene?
kendo negidonjo nyaka ei ute nindo mag ruodhigi.
Nowuoyo, mi pumbi mag lwangʼni nosieko,
nogoyo yiendegi mag mzabibu gi ngʼowu piny
kendo nolwero yiende mane ni e pinygi.
e pinygi koda ka chambgi mane gipidho e puothegi.
Bangʼe nonego nyithindo makayo duto mane ni e pinygi,
kodhi mokwongo duto mane gihango nywolo.
Nogolo Israel, kogangore gi fedha kod dhahabu,
kendo onge ngʼama nodongʼ chien kuom dhout Israel duto.
nikech mbi mar jo-Israel nosegore kuomgi.
Noumogi gi boche polo kaka raum,
kendo noyiengʼogi gi makati mar polo.
Noyawo lwanda, mi pi nowuok gi teko;
kendo pigno nomol ka aora mamol e piny motwo.
adier, nomiyo joge moyier owuok kakok gi mor;
kendo gik ma jomoko nono nochandore ka loso nodoko girkeni magi,
